title: cicerbita benthamii
intro: Cicerbita benthamii, commonly known as the Himalayan mugwort or Bhimsen, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Cicerbita benthamii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Cicerbita benthamii include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
